note: Hand-captured on 2026-11-20, four days before release, by parsing the notes' raw HTML to text with the image positions kept: hero sections are attributed by their banner image (several open with a bare 'General:' heading, e.g. the 690 -> 670 health line after Legion is Lt. Belica's), item sections by their banner filename, and the Eternal sections (headed only by blessing names) by matching each minor to data/game-data/eternals.json. Every 'from' value checked against the 1.18 catalog and eternals.json matched. Bugfix-only heroes (Aurora, Dekker, Greystone, Zarus, Zinx) are under systems, not heroes. The seven new or returning items (Infused Bracers, Stigmata, Bandit's Toll, Heretic's Blade, Shadebinder, Elysia, Kingsbane) are absent from data/catalog until pred.gg publishes 1.18.2.
global: Mage durability pass: Argus, Gadget, Gideon, Howitzer, Iggy & Scorch, Ikra, Lt. Belica, Morigesh, Neon, Renna, The Fey, Valmont and Wraith lose base health or health regen (about -15 health and -0.15 regen at level 1 on average) to make mid lane trades matter again.
Forticus comes down hard: cost 2900 -> 3000, shield 8% -> 6% max health for 3s, cooldown 16-10s, and smaller Swell gains. The notes call it a catch-all buy that non-tanks were poaching.
Shields across the Mage class shrink: Phylactery, Azure Core, the Soulbearer crest, Vyzar Carapace and Vortex Stone all lose shield scaling.
Kaelen is cut across his kit three weeks after release: slower Razorstorm and Frostfall, weaker Frostbite and Last Winter, and lower stat growth.
Six new items (Infused Bracers, Stigmata, Bandit's Toll, Heretic's Blade, Shadebinder, Elysia) and the return of Kingsbane, with a new Hybrid Penetration stat on Infused Bracers and Kingsbane.
Sustain minors come down (From The Abyss, Regenerative Tissue, Mending) and Knell is trimmed again (Patina speed, Fracture damage).
Quests are overhauled with random rewards, a Weekly Quest and daily re-rolls; none of that changes ranked play.

tldr.text: Thirteen mages and mid-lane carries lose base health or regen, so poke now sticks and stalling a lane on regen gets harder. The notes expect some carries to lean into mid lane as a result.

tldr.lead: Forticus and shield stacking are cut
tldr.text: Forticus costs 3000, shields for 6% max health instead of 8% on a 16-10s cooldown, and Swell grows slower. Phylactery, Azure Core, Soulbearer, Vyzar Carapace and Vortex Stone shields shrink too.
Razorstorm and Frostfall come back slower, Heart of Ice slows 12% instead of 15%, Winter's Pursuit's Frostbite bonus drops to 1.75x, and his growth stats and Last Winter shield are lower.

tldr.lead: New items for on-hit and enchanters
tldr.text: Bandit's Toll, Heretic's Blade and Kingsbane give attack-speed heroes new on-hit paths; Shadebinder is a magical bruiser item for Shinbi, Kwang and Aurora; Elysia helps enchanters cast their ultimate more often.
Akeron, Ikra, Legion, Narbash, Rampage, Revenant, Riktor, Scarlett, Shinbi, The Fey and TwinBlast all lose something, each aimed at the habit the notes name.
Adele, Boris, GRIM.exe, Sevarog, Skylar and Wukong gain scaling, cooldowns or utility, and Crunch's model shrinks 5%.

systems.name: Hybrid Penetration
systems.summary: A new stat that grants equal physical and magical penetration (10 Hybrid Penetration = 10 of each), like Omnivamp does for lifesteal. Found on Infused Bracers and Kingsbane.

systems.name: Bug fixes that change play
systems.summary: Aurora's Cryoseism now damages unstoppable heroes and towers prioritize her statue correctly. Dekker's Photon Disruptor hits airborne heroes. Greystone's Tainted Oath now applies its anti-heal. Zarus's thrown Spear of Nyr no longer deals 15% too little to low-health targets. Zinx's Ricochet stun now scales with rank and Neural Regenesis' revive health ignores anti-heal. Iggy's Oil Spill no longer applies 5 Slick stacks at once. Thraex's Savage Strikes no longer pops spell shields. Resonant Repair now refreshes when immobilized repeatedly. Onixian Quiver's Multishot now deals its intended damage, about 10-20% more than before.

systems.name: Quests overhaul
systems.summary: Three daily quests and one weekly quest with random rewards (Battlepass XP, Account XP, Amber, Platinum, Opals, Loot Cores), daily re-rolls for 400 Amber, and in-game quest tracking. Battlepass XP from match completion is up 44% while quests roll out. Cosmetic and progression only.

systems.name: PCC Winter Peak
systems.summary: The esports circuit returns with $8,000 across regions and a LAN invitation; the Top 8 bracket plays December 5-6 and 12-13.

eternals.summary: No new Eternals. Sustain minors come down together, Knell is trimmed for damage heroes a second patch running, and Mage shield sources shrink with Phylactery. Pilow is the one buff.

changes.name: Nihil
changes.change: Major: stat increase on level-up and takedown 20% -> 17.5%. From The Abyss health regen 0.2%/0.4%/0.7%/1% -> 0.2%/0.4%/0.6%/0.8%.
changes.meaning: Less snowball on the durable frontliners the notes say it has been carrying, and less sustain late.

changes.name: Krix
changes.change: Regenerative Tissue health regen 0.2%/0.4%/0.7%/1% -> 0.2%/0.4%/0.6%/0.8%. Bugfix: no more jitter when gaining max health.
changes.meaning: Part of the sustain pass: damage should stick to bulky targets in the late game.

changes.name: Idrisil
changes.meaning: The same sustain cut, on the healing-after-damage minor.

changes.name: Knell
changes.change: Patina movement speed 4% -> 3%. Fracture bonus damage 3.5% -> 3%. Bugfix: Resonant Repair now refreshes its healing when immobilized repeatedly.
changes.meaning: A second straight trim aimed at Scarlett and Eden; the Resonant Repair fix restores value it was losing.

changes.name: Vesh
changes.change: The Tenth Seal ultimate haste 25 -> 20. Phylactery shield max mana scaling 15% -> 12%.
changes.meaning: Less ultimate uptime and smaller mage shields, in step with Azure Core and Soulbearer.

changes.name: Pilow
changes.meaning: Easier to tag several enemies with the damage-reduction debuff in fights.

changes.name: Aion
changes.meaning: A partial revert of its buff: less mana sustain across the laning phase.

changes.name: Thraex
changes.change: Bugfix: Savage Strikes no longer pops spell shields.
changes.meaning: A fix, not a balance change: spell shields now hold against it.

items: Infused Bracers (new, tier 1, 450g): 5 Hybrid Penetration. Builds into Kingsbane.
Stigmata (new, tier 2, 1000g): 25 magical power, 5 ability haste; Hexfire burns for 5 magical damage every 0.75s for 3s, 65% more to monsters. Builds into Megacosm.

Bandit's Toll (new, fighter, 2750g): 40% attack speed, 150 health, 8% lifesteal; basic attacks deal 15 (+5% total physical power per basic ability on cooldown) true damage on-hit; basic attack movement penalty reduced 50% (20% ranged).

Heretic's Blade (new, fighter, 2900g): 40% attack speed, 40 physical armor, 15 ability haste; basic attacks deal 15 (+1 per level) on-hit, 1.5x against slowed or immobilized units; after your ultimate, basic attacks slow 20% for 6s (30s cooldown).

Shadebinder (new, mage, 3000g): 65 magical power, 25% attack speed, 250 health, 15 ability haste; every 3 basic attacks within 3s deal 25 (+25% magical power) (+100% item ability haste) magical damage around the target.
Elysia (new, support, 2350g): 40 magical power, 125% base mana regen, 12% heal and shield power, 25 ultimate haste; after your ultimate, basic cooldowns progress 40% faster for 6s (30s cooldown).
Kingsbane (returning, carry, 3000g): 40% attack speed, 10 Hybrid Penetration, 15 ability haste; basic attacks deal 25 on-hit, +3 per hero hit up to 80, reset after 2.5s without damaging a hero.
Forticus: cost 2900 -> 3000; Immovable shield 8% -> 6% max health and 3.5s -> 3s; cooldown 14-10s -> 16-10s; Swell health 0.6% -> 0.5% and movement speed 4 -> 3.5.
Soulbearer (crest): Anima Shield 100 -> 80, magical power scaling 35% -> 30%, max mana scaling 6% -> 5%.
Winter's Fury (crest): active can now be used while channelling.
Serrated Blade: cost 950 -> 900.
Onixian Quiver: 7% lifesteal -> 7% omnivamp; Multishot bugfix restores its intended damage.
Scattershot: cost 3100 -> 3000; Scatter minion damage 50% -> 70%.
Terminus: shield total physical power scaling 100% -> 85%.
Earthshaker: physical power 45 -> 50.
Mutilator: Devour damage modifier 3x -> 3.5x.
Vyzar Carapace: Shell Smash shield 12% -> 10% max health.
Azure Core: Spirit Shield max mana scaling 12% -> 10%.
Megacosm: Chronomatic Wand replaced by Stigmata in the recipe (still 3000g); Disintegrate deals at least 15 to monsters.
Hexbound Bracers: ability haste 15 -> 10.
Vortex Stone: Eye of the Storm shield 12% -> 10% max health.

itemChanges.name: Bandit's Toll
itemChanges.change: New 2750g fighter on-hit item: 40% attack speed, 150 health, 8% lifesteal. Basic attacks deal 15 (+5% total physical power per basic ability on cooldown) true damage, and your basic attack movement penalty is halved (20% for ranged). The notes aim it at armored targets.

itemChanges.name: Heretic's Blade
itemChanges.change: New 2900g on-hit item with 40 physical armor, 40% attack speed and 15 ability haste. Basic attacks deal 15 (+1 per level), 1.5x against slowed or immobilized units, and for 6s after your ultimate they slow 20% (30s cooldown). The notes name Grux, Serath and Yin.

itemChanges.name: Shadebinder
itemChanges.change: New 3000g magical bruiser item: 65 magical power, 25% attack speed, 250 health, 15 ability haste. Every 3 basic attacks within 3s deal 25 (+25% magical power) (+100% item ability haste) magical damage around the target. The notes name Shinbi, Kwang and Aurora.

itemChanges.name: Elysia
itemChanges.change: New 2350g enchanter item: 40 magical power, 125% base mana regen, 12% heal and shield power and 25 ultimate haste; after your ultimate, basic cooldowns progress 40% faster for 6s (30s cooldown). The notes name Zinx, Muriel and Maco.

itemChanges.name: Kingsbane
itemChanges.change: Returns after about two years, reworked: 3000g, 40% attack speed, 10 Hybrid Penetration, 15 ability haste. Basic attacks deal 25 on-hit, +3 per hero hit up to 80, resetting after 2.5s without damaging a hero.

itemChanges.name: Stigmata
itemChanges.change: New 1000g tier 2 mage component (25 magical power, 5 ability haste) whose Hexfire burns for 5 magical damage every 0.75s for 3s, 65% more to monsters. Builds into Megacosm, for mages in the jungle or early lane.

itemChanges.name: Infused Bracers
itemChanges.change: New 450g tier 1 component with 5 Hybrid Penetration. For now it only builds into Kingsbane.

itemChanges.name: Forticus
itemChanges.change: Cost 2900 -> 3000. Immovable shield 8% -> 6% max health and 3.5s -> 3s, cooldown 14-10s -> 16-10s. Swell health 0.6% -> 0.5% and movement speed 4 -> 3.5. The notes call it a catch-all buy that non-tanks were poaching.

itemChanges.name: Soulbearer
itemChanges.change: Anima Shield 100 -> 80, magical power scaling 35% -> 30%, max mana scaling 6% -> 5%.

itemChanges.name: Azure Core
itemChanges.change: Spirit Shield max mana scaling 12% -> 10%.

itemChanges.name: Vyzar Carapace
itemChanges.change: Shell Smash shield 12% -> 10% max health.

itemChanges.name: Vortex Stone
itemChanges.change: Eye of the Storm shield 12% -> 10% max health.

itemChanges.name: Terminus
itemChanges.change: Shield total physical power scaling 100% -> 85%. The notes name Scarlett, Revenant and Eden rushing it.

itemChanges.name: Hexbound Bracers
itemChanges.change: Ability haste 15 -> 10, aimed at ranged enchanters buying it.

itemChanges.name: Onixian Quiver
itemChanges.change: 7% lifesteal becomes 7% omnivamp, and a bugfix restores Multishot's intended damage (it was about 10-20% low).

itemChanges.name: Scattershot
itemChanges.change: Cost 3100 -> 3000; Scatter minion damage 50% -> 70%.

itemChanges.name: Earthshaker
itemChanges.change: Physical power 45 -> 50.

itemChanges.name: Mutilator
itemChanges.change: Devour damage modifier 3x -> 3.5x against health-stacking targets.

itemChanges.name: Winter's Fury
itemChanges.change: The crest's active can now be used while channelling, such as during Gideon's Black Hole.

itemChanges.name: Megacosm
itemChanges.change: Chronomatic Wand is replaced by Stigmata in the recipe (still 3000g), and Disintegrate deals at least 15 damage to monsters.
